$comment: Document 24, section 6.12. Route A only, R1. Resources cite, never copy. Prompts come later with the playbook skills package (D-18).
description: The read-only MCP resources of the product's own server. Each read returns one content item with mimeType application/json; its text is JSON that matches contentSchema. Rows follow the caller's access like any read.
notFound: An unknown or hidden URI returns the MCP resource not found error. It never reveals whether a hidden row exists.
